org.plan.title: Subscription plan
org.plan.label: Plan name
org.plan.label_placeholder: e.g. MiniMax Max, GLM Coding Pro…
org.plan.reset_in_help: Copied from the provider's screen (e.g. %s, %s). Empty = sliding window.
org.plan.scope_help: Models published under several names but pointing to the same upstream model are metered together.
org.plan.scope_provider_help: Every model of the provider counts against the budgets above.
org.plan.scope_model_help: Each model of the provider has its own window and the budgets above, for plans that limit each model separately.
org.plan.scope_shared_help: Every model counts against the budgets above, each at its own rate: a model whose own budget below is twice the constraint's fills the window half as fast. For plans that publish a usage limit per model but meter a single window (OpenCode Go).
org.plan.model_budgets_help: One upstream model per line, in the form %s: %s, %s, %s. A budget listed here replaces the constraint's budgets for that model; with shared metering, it sets the rate at which the model fills them.
org.plan.fairshare_help: Each user's share is a floor guaranteed to all members, plus the remainder split among only the users active in the window. Leave empty for the default values.
org.plan.reserve_help: Share of the budget reserved equally among all members, including those who do not consume.
org.plan.pace_slack_help: Consumption lead tolerated over the elapsed window before shares tighten.
org.plan.happy_start_help: Fraction of the window beyond which the remainder, which would be lost at reset, is split among active users. 100 disables the opening.
org.plan.happy_lead: Maximum lead of the opening (default: 5%% of the window, between 30 min and 4 h)
org.plan.happy_lead_help: Absolute bound: on a long window, the fraction above would open hours before the reset. A 5 h window opens 30 min before, a weekly window 4 h before.
org.plan.share_threshold_help: How full the plan may get before the shares apply. Below it anyone may consume, the plan having room for everyone. Empty or 0: shares from the first request.
org.provider.name: Name
org.provider.api_key_keep: API key (leave empty to keep the current one)
org.provider.api_key_retype: The API key is never shown again: enter it again.
org.provider.api_keys_help: Keys of the same subscription held besides the provider's own, such as the keys of the members of a team plan. The plan applies to each key: its budgets count once per key. Each user is kept on one key, where the cache of their conversations lives, and moved to another only when theirs is exhausted. Users never see the keys.
org.provider.api_keys_value_keep: Leave blank to keep the current key
org.provider.api_keys_overrides: Adjust the plan for this key
org.provider.api_keys_overrides_help: For a member whose subscription holds other budgets or renews on another day. A field left empty keeps the plan's.
org.provider.api_keys_override_models: Per-model budgets replacing the plan's, e.g. kimi-k3 = 3
org.provider.delete_warning: Deleting this provider also deletes the models it exposes; calls that name them will fail immediately.
org.provider.delete_title: Delete this provider and all its models?
org.provider.delete_description: All attached models will be deleted with it and will no longer be served. This action cannot be undone.
org.provider.models_description: Proxy names exposed by this provider, and their costs per million tokens in %s.
org.provider.session_header_help: Name of the header that carries the conversation identifier, for gateways that require it (x-opencode-session for OpenCode Go). Xolo puts the identifier sent by the client (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) in it, or else a fingerprint of the conversation. Leave empty to send nothing.
org.provider.fixed_headers_help: Added to every request, they replace those of the HTTP client (User-Agent included). No secrets here: only the API key is encrypted. Authentication, cookie, transport and forwarding headers (X-Forwarded-For…) are refused.
org.model.kind_help: A completion model answers the /chat/completions and /messages routes, an embeddings model answers /embeddings. A decision model answers /decisions: typed questions about a state, answers as probabilities (TypeSafe Jev models, through the typesafe or openrouter type). Virtual models and middlewares only serve completion.
org.model.cached_prompt_cost: Cached prompt cost per million tokens (%s)
org.model.cached_prompt_cost_help: Rate applied to tokens served from the provider's cache (prompt caching).
org.model.eco_estimate_help: Leave at 0 for an automatic estimate.
org.model.api_type_help: Change it when the provider serves this model through an API other than its own. OpenCode Go, for example, serves some models as openai and others as anthropic. The anthropic type does not serve embeddings.
org.model.base_url_help: Leave empty to keep the provider's.
org.model.extra_body_help: Key/value pairs injected as-is into the body of every request sent to this model (provider-specific parameters, e.g. reasoning_split = true for MiniMax M3). The type is inferred from the value: true/false -> boolean, a number -> numeric, otherwise text.
org.model.delete_description: Calls that name it will fail as soon as it is deleted.
